title: Rearing pen: how does a farm configure it?
detail: Owner decision 2026-10-10: a rearing pen ("rescue deck") is a farm-level option. When the farm has one, a dead sow's allocation sheet offers "Move to a rearing pen"; otherwise the option is absent. The prototype has a flag (on for the demo, ?rearing=off turns it off) and the option moves every remaining piglet in one tap. Still open: where the farm declares the pen (a console setting, a pen type), whether the move names the pen when the farm has several, and whether the piglets then get a record there.
options: The farm marks one pen as its rearing pen in the console; the option moves the piglets there
Any pen of a rearing type can be picked on a second step
Keep the demo flag until the console is designed
recommendation: One rearing pen per unit, marked in the console; the option names it and moves the piglets in one tap.

title: Animal ID format: what do real ear tags look like?
detail: Length, characters, visual tag vs electronic (15-digit) tag, and whether a farm short ID exists. Today's 6-digit IDs are placeholders, and list and search design depend on the answer (how the ID is set in a row, what Find a sow matches, whether a pen is a grouping unit with many sows). Status: open, owner to confirm.
options: One ID per animal as printed on the visual tag, set in full
A farm short ID (the last digits, or a farm number) shown first, the full tag one tap away
Both: electronic 15-digit tag for scanning, a short visual ID for reading
recommendation: Ask the owner for real tags from two farms before the room list's ID treatment is designed.
